<thought>We need a valid CIF for the CO₂ molecule and a correctly formatted CIF for the silicon slab (using “data_Si” instead of “_data_Si”). We'll provide a simple CO₂ CIF with a large cubic cell and place it on the slab using the default top site and a 2 Å height. The tool will return the combined CIF, which we will write to a file and then output its path.</thought>
